1.explanation: 1. DataTable/README.md – shows the toolbar prop API, how the table toolbar is configured (aria-label, renderToolbar). 2. DataTable/stories/WithToolbar.stories.js – the exact story used in the screenshot; you can reproduce the layout, titles, and aria-labels for the overflow and button. 3. DataTable/stories/DataTable.stories.js – contains the DataTable story definitions and knobs; helps you launch the same storybook environment. 4. DataTable/tools/toolbar-helpers.js – internal helpers that assemble the toolbar actions and set aria-attributes. 5. ToolbarSearch/index.js – implements the expandable search icon container, whose markup lives in the toolbar. 6. Button/index.js – the primary Button component, to inspect how title, aria-label, and visible text combine to form the accessible name.
1.bug_scenario: The violation occurs in the DataTable “With toolbar” story: above the table there is a toolbar containing three controls – a collapsible search container (magnifier icon), an overflow‐menu icon button (gear/settings), and a “Primary Button.” DAP flags an IBM 2.5.3 Label in Name violation on the overflow‐menu icon (title=“Settings” but aria-label=“Menu”) and/or the primary button (its accessible name doesn’t match the visible text). In the image the toolbar lives inside a <section aria-label=“data table toolbar” class=“bx–table–toolbar”> wrapper, and the two buttons are rendered with class “bx–toolbar–action” (overflow‐menu) and “bx–btn–primary” (primary button).
